大卫的生活方式(David's Way of Living): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:大卫的经历、感受与成长。

The shopping mall looked quieter than usual that evening. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The cashier has become an important part of daily life. He took a loan and is now in debt.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. David has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. The dish smells of garlic.
The experience taught David more than any book could. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Eight pounds for water is a rip-off.
Little by little, things began to change. Tom advised David to try dancing as a new hobby. David's dream job is to be a engineer. In fact, a pleated skirt catches the fan.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. People around David often share different ideas about the shopping mall. David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
